title: Import BOQ Items from Excel
shortDescription: Bring in a batch of BOQ items from a spreadsheet.
steps: Select Project
Upload Excel
Import BOQ Items
requiredFields: Excel file with columns: name, item_type, unit, boq_qty
warnings: Always enter the quantity according to the unit — e.g. Cable → MTR → 500, Pole → NOS → 20, Material → KG → 1000.

title: Add a BOQ Item Manually
shortDescription: Add a single item to a project's BOQ by hand.
steps: Select Project
Add Item Details
Save All Items
warnings: Always enter the quantity according to the unit — e.g. Cable → MTR → 500, Pole → NOS → 20, Material → KG → 1000.

title: Find or Filter Items
shortDescription: Locate an item already in the BOQ / item master.
steps: Use the Search Bar to search by Name or Code
Use Filters to narrow down further

title: Add a New Vendor
steps: Enter Vendor Name
Enter GST Number (optional)
Enter Status
Enter Contact Person Name
Enter Phone Number
Enter Email Address
Enter Address
Bank details are optional (Bank Name, Account Number, IFSC Code)
Click Create Vendor

title: Search or Filter Vendors
shortDescription: Find an existing vendor by name, GST, contact, bank details, status, or date.
steps: Use the Search Bar to search by Name, GST, Contact, or Bank Details
Use the Status Filter to select Active / Inactive / All
Use the Date Filter to select the required date

title: Create a Purchase Order
shortDescription: Raise a new Purchase Order for a project or the office.
steps: Select PO Type — Project or Office
Select Vendor from dropdown (if vendor not listed, contact Admin)
Add PO Details — PO Number is generated automatically, edit if required
Add Items — Project PO: select Material/BOQ → enter Qty → enter Unit Price. Office PO: enter Item Description → Unit → Qty → Unit Price
Tick 'Include Advance Payment' if required
Tick 'Is DI Required?' if a Dispatch Instruction will follow
Check details, then click Create PO
warnings: Material must already be available in the Item Master/BOQ. If it isn't, contact Admin.

title: Find a Previous Purchase Order
shortDescription: Look up an existing PO using the search bar or filters.
steps: Use the Search Bar / Filters
Filter by PO Number, Type, Vendor, Project, DI Required, Status, Created By, or Date
warnings: PO Amount CANNOT be used for searching or filtering.

title: View a Purchase Request
shortDescription: Review a project's material purchase request.
steps: Select the required request from the list
View Project & Site, Requested By, Requested Date & Time, and Items
Click the Items dropdown to view requested materials

title: Find a Purchase Request
shortDescription: Locate a request by number, project, requester, or role.
steps: Use the Search Bar to search by PR Number, Project, or Requester
Select a Role: All Roles, Senior Site Supervisor, Site Supervisor, or Store Manager

title: Create a Dispatch Instruction
shortDescription: Register a dispatch instruction against an approved PO.
steps: Select PO — choose the required PO (Project, Store, and Contact Details are filled in automatically; edit if required)
Select Material from the PO and enter required details
Check details, then click Register DI
warnings: Only materials available in the selected PO can be added.
If a PO is not approved within 3 days, contact the Director.
result: Status flow: Create DI → DI Pending → DI Registered → Sent to Office for Approval.

title: Find a Dispatch Instruction
shortDescription: Look up a DI by number, related PO, project, store, or person.
steps: Use the Search Bar to search by DI Number, PO Number, Project, Store, or Person
Use Filters for Project, Store, Created By, or Date

title: Punch In / Punch Out Attendance
shortDescription: Record your daily work attendance location and times.
steps: Navigate to Attendance → My Attendance
To start work: Click Punch In → Allow GPS Location prompt
To end work: Click Punch Out → Allow GPS Location prompt
warnings: GPS Location permission MUST be enabled and allowed for both Punch In and Punch Out.

title: Submit Leave Request
shortDescription: Apply for time off by submitting a leave request.
steps: Navigate to Attendance → Submit Leave Request
Select From Date
Select To Date
Enter Reason / Notes
Click Submit Leave Application

title: Check Leave History & Status
shortDescription: Review your past leave applications and their current approval status.
steps: Navigate to Attendance → My Leave History
View summary metrics: Total Applied | Pending Review | Approved | Rejected
